name: DataForSEO MCP
summary: DataForSEO's official MCP server gives your agent its paid SEO data APIs, as a hosted endpoint or a server you run yourself.
signIn: OAuth on the hosted server, or a header with your DataForSEO API login and password. The local npx or Docker server takes the login and password as environment variables.
tools: 4 tools (docs_index, docs_list_sections, docs_search, api_request), listed in the GitHub README.
free: $1 trial credit for new accounts, usable through MCP. A free Sandbox returns sample responses.
price: Pay as you go with no subscription. $50 minimum top-up, and the balance never expires. Each API has its own rates. Prices in USD.
writeActions: No Google Search Console access or write actions stated. The api_request tool makes authenticated DataForSEO API requests, which are billed to the account balance.
pickIf: You want the whole DataForSEO API in your agent, from SERPs and keywords to backlinks and on-page data.
You want to set spending limits per account, API or endpoint.
You want to run the server yourself from npx or Docker.

sources.fact: Hosted URL, sign in, clients, APIs covered
Pay as you go, $50 minimum, $1 trial, spending limits
